title: BankLedger: browser perf, search and backfill
cluster_summary: All three findings are local to BankLedger and need no upstream change. BL-R-04 is a real ux inconsistency: the search filter stores raw box text, but the suggestion list trims it. The finding's example is wrong ('linen ' does match 'Linen Cloth'); ' linen' and 'cloth ' are the real failing inputs. The fix is one trim helper in modules/Browser.lua. BL-R-03 (redundant recompute from an un-cancelled debounce and a double paint on tab switch) is cheap and optional, so bundle it into the same Browser.lua edit. BL-R-06 (backfill budget starvation) gets recorded as a Known Limitation with no code change.

verdicts.assessment: Confirmed in code. OnTextChanged (Browser.lua:1096), SetSearchText (:666) and buildActiveFilter store the raw text, Database textOK (:457-461) does a plain lowered substring find, and _rankSuggestions trims first (:607-608). The cited example is wrong, because 'linen ' is a substring of 'linen cloth'. Leading, trailing-after-last-word or doubled whitespace (' linen', 'cloth ') does empty the table while the suggestions still offer Linen Cloth.
verdicts.remediation: C-04: add a searchClause(t) helper that trims (and returns nil when the result is empty), and use it in OnTextChanged, SetSearchText and buildActiveFilter so the query and the suggestions normalize the same way. Add one test case using ' linen' or 'cloth '.

verdicts.assessment: Confirmed. ApplyView calls SetText (:879), which in the client arms the 0.2 s debounce through OnTextChanged, then calls ApplyFilterNow (:882) without cancelling the timer, so the same filter runs a second time. SelectTab (:238-242) repaints LedgerTable and Insights after SwapTabState has already refreshed them. This is redundant work with no correctness impact, and the cost has not been measured.
verdicts.remediation: C-03, in the same Browser.lua commit as C-04: a shared dropFilterDebounce() helper used by both SetSearchText and ApplyView. In SelectTab, skip the redundant LedgerTable:Refresh/Insights:Refresh only on a real switch (prev ~= name) and still call RefreshFilterOptions on History. Add two test cases and no perf instrumentation. Skip C-03 if Browser.lua is not being edited.

verdicts.assessment: Confirmed. Backfill.Collect walks oldest-first and caps at BACKFILL_MAX_IDS = 40, and unresolvable ids are never marked, so they are retried first on every login. Starvation needs 40 or more distinct unresolvable ids. Retention, which is account-wide in db.global (retentionDays = 30, not a profile setting), ages them out, except when retention is set to Always. The case is theoretical and has never been observed.
